segments.he: זֶה אוֹמֵר שְׁאוּלָה, וְזֶה אוֹמֵר שְׂכוּרָה – יִשָּׁבַע הַשּׂוֹכֵר שֶׁשְּׂכוּרָה מֵתָה.
segments.en: § The mishna teaches: The bailee rented one cow and borrowed another one. «This» owner «says» with certitude: The «borrowed» cow is the one that died. «And that» renter «says» with certitude: The «rented» cow is the one that died. In this case, «the renter takes an oath that the rented» cow is the one that «died» and then he is exempt.
